definitions.explanation: The chemical element mercury (Hg), a silvery liquid metal. Historically used in thermometers, barometers, and various industrial applications. Now restricted due to toxicity.

examples.japanese: {水銀|すいぎん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{常温|じょうおん}→常温：14722_jouon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧だ。
examples.english: Mercury is a liquid at room temperature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水銀|すいぎん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

{水銀|すいぎん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人体|じんたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Mercury is harmful to the human body, so sufficient care is needed when handling it.

notes:
USAGE:
{水銀|すいぎん} refers specifically to the metallic element mercury. In Japanese, the word literally combines ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) and ⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧ (silver), reflecting the element's liquid, silvery appearance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水銀|すいぎん}{灯|とう} (mercury lamp)
- {水銀|すいぎん}⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧ (mercury poisoning)
- {水銀|すいぎん}⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧ (mercury thermometer)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Minamata disease ({水俣病|みなまたびょう}) caused by mercury pollution is one of Japan's most well-known environmental disasters.
